metadata.title: AI Boom Drives a Jump in Lending, but Bankers Still Sound Cautious - WSJ

content.text:
At the end of a previous lending boom, back in 2007, then-Citigroup C 1.36%increase; up pointing triangle CEO Charles Prince famously said: “As long as the music is playing, you’ve got to get up and dance.”
This time around, with artificial intelligence now a driving force, banks are definitely up and dancing. But they are also eyeing possible seats and listening more keenly for a pause in the music.
